notes: ACCESS: robots.txt fetched first - it names no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web agent; its only relevant rules are the prefv/prefn/dwcont/srule facet params, */search/*, */cart/, */current-promotions/*, */at-home-deals/* and a blanket Disallow for the literal user-agent 'python-requests/2.24.0' (not used here); no Crawl-delay applies to '*'. As in the prior Furniture pass the SEO HTML on www.athome.com sits behind an Akamai challenge, so every read went through the storefront's own Salesforce Commerce Cloud controllers on Sites-athome-sfra-Site, which are served unchallenged to curl_cffi (winning profiles rotated: safari15_5, chrome124, chrome131): /on/demandware.store/Sites-athome-sfra-Site/default/Search-Refinebar?cgid=<slug> for the tree + count, and /Search-UpdateGrid?cgid=<slug>&start=&sz= for enumeration. No proxy. Every recorded link is the canonical origin URL and all 4 recorded leaves plus all 8 review links were confirmed present in https://www.athome.com/sitemap_2.xml (1239 category URLs). TREE: taken from the SFCC catalogue itself. The Refinebar left-nav renders the department tree with the requested node marked is-current; a node that is a leaf carries the class 'no-subcat'. Bathroom lives at Bed & Bath > Bath (cgid=bath, 'Show 1,201 Items') with exactly 8 children in this site order: Shower Curtains & Accessories, Bathroom Accessories, Bathroom Rugs & Bath Mats, Bath Towels & Washcloths, Bathroom Storage & Organization, Bath Hardware, Bathroom Cleaning & Care, Shop All Bath. Each of the 7 real children was re-queried on its own cgid and every one came back 'l2-cat no-subcat is-current' - i.e. all are true leaves with no L4, so there are no deeper nodes to record and the parent /bath/ URL is correctly NOT recorded (rule 24). 'Shop All Bath' is excluded under rule 25. QTY: every number is the site's own rendered filter-bar header 'Show N Items' for that exact cgid, and EVERY ONE was then independently corroborated by paging Search-UpdateGrid to exhaustion (sz=100) and counting unique data-pid values - all matched exactly, with no page-boundary shortfall: Bathroom Accessories 240=240, Bathroom Storage & Organization 93=93, Bath Hardware 30=30, Bathroom Cleaning & Care 134=134, Shower Curtains & Accessories 223=223, Bathroom Rugs & Bath Mats 231=231, Bath Towels & Washcloths 316=316, and the Bath parent 1201=1201. Counts discriminate strongly (30 to 316) so no site-wide constant is being read, and the parent 1201 is larger than every child. VERIFICATION: each Refinebar response was checked to carry the requested slug as the is-current/selected node (data-cat 'Bathroom Accessories', 'Bath Hardware', 'Shower Curtains & Accessories' ...) before its header was accepted, so no page silently served a fallback. Grid samples were read to classify each node on primary product type, not name: Bathroom Accessories = tumblers, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders, soap trays (rule 13); Bath Hardware = tension shower-curtain rods, shower rods, spa racks, tiered bathroom storage stands (rule 17); Bathroom Cleaning & Care = toilet bowl brushes, step bins, bathroom wastebaskets (rules 3, 14). EXCLUDED: 'Shop All Bath' /bath-shop-all/ and 'Shop All Bed & Bath' (rule 25 View All/Shop All). Rooms > Bathroom /bathroom/ returns 'Show 0 Items' - a genuinely empty room-navigation node, not a lookup failure (a fabricated cgid returns HTTP 410 with no header, a real-but-empty one returns 200 with 'Show 0 Items'), so no row. College Dorm Room > Dorm Bath /dorm-bath/ (128) is a seasonal room collection, excluded under rule 25. Rugs > Bath Rugs & Mats /bath-rugs-mats/ (231) is the same node as Bath > Bathroom Rugs & Bath Mats reached by a second nav path - deduplicated (rule 28) and routed to Textile once. Rugs by Room > Bathroom Rugs /bathroomrugs/ (3) likewise textile. Wall Art & Mirrors > Mirrors (196) and its children Rectangle / Floor & Full-Length / Round / Unique / Mirror Sets are general decorative wall mirrors with no bathroom or vanity node anywhere in the subtree, so they are Wall Decor, not Bathroom (rule 21); At Home publishes no bathroom-mirror, vanity-unit, basin, tap, toilet, bath or shower-enclosure category at all - the whole sitemap was grepped for bath|shower|toilet|vanit|mirror|sink|faucet|soap|towel|medicine|hamper|plunger|tub|caddy|makeup|dispens and every hit was resolved to one of the nodes accounted for above. NOTHING under the Furniture department is bathroom furniture. ROUTED OUT: 3 textile nodes and 5 non-Bath-department nodes, all listed in review with exact counts and URLs.
